visual_goal: Show Northmere's 2027 baseline: three ledgers meeting only at consolidation in OneStream, with most volume flowing through the custom Stayloft Finance Platform before it reaches the group core.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape illustration. Three horizontal lanes. Top lane: a box 'Stayloft' and a box 'Northmere Pay' at the far left, each with a very thick green pipe into a large box 'Finance Platform', which has a very thick pipe into a large open book with its label written once underneath it: 'S/4HANA'. Middle lane: a box 'Wayfare' with a thin arrow into an open book labeled underneath 'Oracle Fusion'. Bottom lane: a box 'Tablekin' with a thin arrow into an open book labeled underneath 'Workday Financials'. The book pages are blank. At the far right a single tall tower labeled 'OneStream'. One arrow from each of the three open books into 'OneStream'. The three lanes are separated by faint lines so the three ledgers touch only at the tower. Exactly eight arrows and pipes.
alt: Three lanes: Stayloft and Northmere Pay feed thick flows through the custom Finance Platform into S/4HANA, Wayfare feeds Oracle Fusion, Tablekin feeds Workday Financials, and the three ledgers meet only at OneStream.

visual_goal: Show Program Keystone as three plateaus after the baseline, each a flat, stable level of its own.
prompt: A left-to-right rising landscape of flat mesas, like terraces. At the far left, low ground with a small messy pile of loose papers, labeled 'Baseline 2026'. Then three wide flat terraces, each higher than the last. On each terrace stands one small tidy house and one small tree, nothing else. The terraces are labeled 'Year 1 Stabilize', 'Year 3 One core', 'Year 5 Real-time'. A path with one arrow climbs from each level to the next. Exactly three arrows.
alt: Rising terraces from a cluttered 2026 baseline to three flat plateaus: stabilize in year 1, one finance core in year 3 and real-time finance in year 5.
